page.running_head: Animal, in dulcib. aquis Ordo II.

main_text.p: ac nullo unquam limo turbidis, qua profundissimi sunt, agere gaudent, in eisq; solis Margaritas concipiunt, &c. Sunt etiam ciusdem fere generis Conchae in oris Hispanicis, quarum testas qui peregre à diuo Iacobo redeunt, adferunt, sed haud fœcundæ, propterea quòd aqua salsa uiuant. Nam & circunquaque in litoribus Scotici maris ingens natat, sed sterilis multitudo. Hæc ille.
MVSCVLVS aquæ dulcis, reperitur autem maximè in aqua stagnante, ferè nunquam in rapidis fluminibus. GALL. Moule. GERM. ein Muschel auß süssen wassern.

CONCHAE longæ species in dulcibus aquis: cuius testam altera parte eius interna expressam hic exhibemus, altera nō uidi, sed binas similes esse puto, & ginglymo articulari. Superficies externa scabra est: qua adempta interior lævis candicat margaritiferæ conchæ instar. Belloni us cum testam apud me uidisseт, Pinnam fl. uocandam putabat, quòd & erecta stet, & margaritas contineat. GERM. Ein Langmuscheln in süssen wassern/soll Perle halten.
COCHLEA terrestris: Limax à limo, authore Festo. Κοχλος ἢ νοχλιας χερσαῖος. Λεμαξ, animal simile Cochleæ, Hesychius.

page.notes: Woodcuts: mussel shell exterior; interior of a long shell showing hinge; two snails (a land snail with tentacles and a second snail with coiled shell). Greek words in the snail caption are transcribed as legible; the second Greek phrase is uncertain. The mussel entry heading "MVSCVLVS" is printed as a large initial and may not be a true heading.
